description: Public audio-only copies of OBS recordings. Original videos remain local and are excluded from Git.
verification_command: ffmpeg -v error -nostdin -i INPUT -map 0:a:0 -f f32le -c:a pcm_f32le pipe:1
verification: SHA-256 and byte length of complete decoded native-rate interleaved float32 audio match for each original and published copy.
split_clips: Existing MP3 clips are unchanged. Split manifest source names and file hashes now identify the published M4A containers; all decoded sample boundaries remain valid.
historical_results: Earlier reports and model metadata may reference original MP4 paths and hashes. The matching decoded audio hashes below connect them to these M4A copies; their historical container hashes should not be rewritten.
